description: Records how a post-service check-in went, as the check-in task card's outcome buttons do: reached_happy or reached_concern (a note is required for reached_concern and callback_due), no_answer, voicemail or callback_due; sentiment overrides the default on a reached outcome. task_id is the check-in task (read tasks). This files the client's words against the visit's assigned cleaners (a concern can start the Complaint flow), and the answer's warnings say what could not happen. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a same task+outcome+day writes once.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: record_checkin_outcome
title: Record a post-service check-in outcome
